headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Retains Monetary Policy Rate at 23% Citing Inflation Risks
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria maintained its Monetary Policy Rate at 23% following a meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee, citing ongoing inflationary risks.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions determine commercial borrowing costs and influence foreign portfolio flows in African emerging markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: The central bank rate decision applies directly to Nigeria's economy.
